invoiceId.description: Set once the load is invoiced (BR-14)

PreconditionFailedDto.description: Body of a 412 on a load write: who saved the newer version and when (IC-67)

FleetSuggestionDto.description: Most recently used compatible pair: the carrier's latest assignment whose driver and truck are both eligible for this load

suggestion.description: Most recently used driver and truck pair from this carrier's assignments (latest assignedAt first), excluding the load's current pair, where both are still eligible for this load; null when none fits. Offered, never pre-selected.

polyline.description: Planned road route through every stop as an encoded polyline (precision 5). It starts and ends at the rounded stop points and never passes closer to a facility than city level.

miles.description: Road miles of the whole route

DocumentPreviewDto.description: Short-lived link that renders the document inline (IC-58); previewable is false for types the browser cannot show

AcceptInvitationDto.description: A signed-in member sends email; a newcomer sends fullName, password and termsVersion.

onTimeRate.description: Share of deliveries inside their window

state.description: Reported by the ELD integration; lost once the last reading is older than the integration's freshness window

driverId.description: Default driver paired with a truck; always null for a trailer

eld.description: ELD link state for a truck; null for a trailer

currentLoadId.description: Active load the vehicle is assigned to, if any

vin.description: 17 characters, no I, O or Q; unique within the carrier

plate.description: Unique within the carrier together with plateState

version.description: Required when updating; refused with 412 when a colleague saved first

truckUnit.description: Unit of the truck the driver is paired with by default

invitations.description: Open and expired driver invitations; accepted and revoked ones drop out

timeZone.description: The carrier's time zone, for invitation dates
